# speckit-clarify

Use when a spec is still ambiguous.

## Instructions

1. Read `.specify/templates/commands/clarify.md`, the feature spec, and the constitution.
2. Identify at most 5 high-impact gaps.
3. Ask targeted questions and explain why each matters.
4. Encode answers back into the spec and clear resolved markers.
